fit_reason: This is a wooden stitch-and-glue sea kayak finished in epoxy and varnish, not a car, truck, motorcycle, boat with gelcoat or paint, PWC or pontoon we detail. The finish was freshly varnished and is outside our services.
findings: High-gloss varnish finish across the deck and hull with clear reflections in every photo
Clean cockpit interior with seat visible and no visible dirt or clutter
Deck bungees and fittings look tidy and intact
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Shearwater kayak and the varnish work looks excellent, with a deep gloss on the deck and hull. Honestly it already presents very well and a wood-and-varnish boat isn't something we'd work on. If you ever have a car, truck or gelcoat boat that needs a pre-sale detail, we come to you. Would you like us to keep your contact for that?
